notes.title: PASSIONERS Update is Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a brand-new update for PASSIONERS! Our team has been working behind the scenes to refine your experience, ensuring that everything flows as smoothly as your most intimate fantasies. With this latest patch, you can expect visual polish, subtle quality-of-life improvements, and enhanced performance that keeps things hot and hassle-free.

While the changes may not all be visible at first glance, you’ll feel the difference in every sensual interaction. Thanks for joining us on this steamy journey — more content is coming soon, and it's only getting spicier from here!

notes.title: Collectible Card Update: New Badges and Profile Backgrounds!
notes.notes:
Great news for all PASSIONERS fans! We've just launched an exciting update that introduces collectible trading cards, shiny new badges, and exclusive profile backgrounds. Dive deeper into your cosmic journey by unlocking these unique rewards and showcasing them on your Steam profile. Complete your set to unlock special avatars and display your passion for PASSIONERS in style.

Ready to start collecting and show off your achievements? The adventure awaits—get started today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446150/d4364d4a8c0a4cbfdfcced406d44cc33d6e701d4.png[/img]

notes.title: RELEASE
notes.notes: PASSIONERS has officially launched, and it’s time to dive into the excitement! Explore the cosmos, seduce your fellow colonists, and indulge in your deepest desires. Enjoy new dialogue options, steamy X-scenes, and multiple endings that will leave you craving more. Interactive animations add depth to every moment, making the experience even more immersive. Embark on a thrilling galactic adventure and discover a universe filled with passion like never before![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446150/f6f9d1ab9cc4eb66181be09486f2a6a1d8219f11.png[/img]

notes.title: Future Colonists, Get Ready for Adventure!
notes.notes:
Only 3 days left until the release of PASSIONERS, and time is flying fast! 🌌 Prepare for thrilling space exploration, untamed desires, and choices that will shape the fate of your colony. 🚀

To be among the first to embark on this cosmic journey, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist! It’s the best way to stay connected and make sure you don’t miss the release.

Soon, you’ll be part of a new galactic story. Will you lead the colonists to prosperity, or give in to more... sensual temptations? The choice is yours.

🔥 Add to your wishlists and get ready for liftoff! 🔥
